clarity.notes: Highly intuitive developer-oriented step-by-step form navigation with instantaneous visual feedback, validations, and a clean layout.

hierarchy.notes: Clear visual dominance of the active step container card. Headers, sub-captions, and forms follow natural reading paths.

typography.notes: Strict tracking applied (negative tracking for titles, positive letter-spacing for uppercase labels). Pure Inter font-stack with compliant leading.

motion.notes: Subtle UI transition timing on navigation, overlays, and button hovers. Includes active progress loaders.

brand.notes: 100% compliant with the Product design tokens, palette colors, and 8px border posture. Only allowed color hex literals are defined.
